blurb: Guests can visit the taproom located in Milwaukee's Historic Third Ward to enjoy a variety of craft beers including rotating releases and taproom favorites. The taproom features a cool, laid back brick-lined Rathskeller with room for friends. They host live music and magic performances on select evenings and offer private event bookings.
